title: Reorg, Rebase, and the 2026 Credit Bomb
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

Bitcoin just experienced a two-block reorg at height 941,880—and Foundry USA erased competing pools while everyone watched price. That's hashrate dominance in real time. When a single miner controls 30 percent of global hash, reorgs stop being glitches and become power statements. Watch for mining pool consolidation to become the next regulatory target.

Meanwhile, the macro credit bomb is ticking toward 2026. Largest corporate bond issuance year ever on record. Defaults cascade
